description: Resolve a taxonomy record by NCBI taxon ID (e.g. 9606) or scientific name (e.g. "Homo sapiens") — provide exactly one. Returns the scientific and common name, mnemonic, rank, parent, and the full lineage. Set include_children to also fetch immediate child taxa (a separate lookup — not inline on the record) in pages of 100 with the total child count; when more remain, pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page. Use this to turn an organism name into the taxon ID that uniprot_search_proteins (organism_id) and uniprot_get_proteome (taxon_id) expect.

cursor.description: Forward-pagination cursor from a prior children page, for the next page of the same taxon; a cursor issued for another taxon is rejected. Only meaningful with include_children.

include_children.description: When true, also fetch a page of up to 100 immediate child taxa via a follow-up search. Defaults to false.

name.description: Organism scientific name, e.g. "Homo sapiens". Provide this OR taxon_id, not both. Matched against the scientific name.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy ID, e.g. 9606. Provide this OR name, not both.

name: uniprot_get_taxonomy

cap.description: The page size that was applied, when more remain.

childCount.description: Number of immediate children on this page (when include_children is true).

children.description: One page of immediate children (up to 100). Present only when include_children is true.

cursor.description: Forward cursor for the next children page. Absent on the last page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_identifier`: Neither taxon_id nor name was provided. `conflicting_identifier`: Both taxon_id and name were provided. `not_found`: The taxon ID or name did not resolve to a record. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor was issued for another taxon, is malformed, or UniProt could not continue from it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lineage.description: Full lineage from root to the taxon's near ancestor.

items.description: A node in the lineage, ordered root → near.

commonName.description: Common name of the node. Omitted when none.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the lineage node.

taxonId.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the lineage node.

notice.description: Paging guidance when more children remain — the total and how to continue.

shown.description: Number of children on this page, when more remain.

mnemonic.description: UniProt organism mnemonic, e.g. "HUMAN". Omitted when none.

otherNames.description: Synonyms and alternative spellings. Omitted when none.

parent.description: Immediate parent taxon. Omitted at the root.

totalChildren.description: Total immediate children of the taxon across all pages (when include_children is true).

truncated.description: True when more children remain past this page — fetch them with cursor.

title: uniprot-mcp-server: get taxonomy
